text: This pawn's body is capable of absorbing prey, both permanently (assimilation) and temporarily (amalgamation).

This pawn's ovaries can produce an enzyme which converts living tissues into eggs.
This pawn's organ lining can produce an enzyme which converts living tissues into urine.
This pawn has heavily-modified cleavage for cleavage vore.
This pawn has a permeable membrane for skin, allowing them to engulf prey, like a slime, for membrane vore.

This tail has a petal-like maw at the tip, which is capable of swallowing prey down to the stomach.
